records.name: Bäcker Frühzustand
records.biography_en: Has already done tomorrow's work before today has explained itself. His peel delivers HyperNorm bread before the official morning begins. A dissonant card arrives hungry rather than punctual. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Morgen ist fertig. Heute darf noch schlafen.

variant_notes.note_en: Has already done tomorrow's work before today has explained itself.

records.name: Konditorin Zuckerrang
records.biography_en: Can make a grievance look beautifully presentable. Her cake layers keep HyperNorm sweetness and grievance neatly separated. A dissonant card notices that the cream touches both. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Beschwerde wurde mit Zuckerrand versehen.

variant_notes.note_en: Can make a grievance look beautifully presentable.

records.name: Bäckerin Sauerhalt
records.biography_en: Treats the starter as a colleague whose terms remain unclear. Her HyperNorm starter jar grows beyond the approved mark each night. A dissonant card calls that cooperation rather than a fault. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Mitarbeit ist lebendig und schwer kündbar.

variant_notes.note_en: Treats the starter as a colleague whose terms remain unclear.

records.name: Chocolatier Bruchkante
records.biography_en: Trusts a clean snap more than an enthusiastic endorsement. His HyperNorm chocolate must break along prescribed lines. A dissonant card saves the uneven corner for somebody having an uneven day. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Empfehlung hält dem Bruchtest nicht stand.

variant_notes.note_en: Trusts a clean snap more than an enthusiastic endorsement.

records.name: Orbitalbäcker Schwerelos
records.biography_en: Cannot tell whether the dough has risen or the rest of the bakery has fallen. His sealed HyperNorm dough dome records rising without committing to up. A dissonant card wonders who is actually moving. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Aufgehen bleibt eine Frage des Bezugsrahmens.

variant_notes.note_en: Cannot tell whether the dough has risen or the rest of the bakery has fallen.

records.name: Pâtissier Endglasur
records.biography_en: Believes every conclusion deserves one last unnecessary flourish. His piping bag adds a final HyperNorm flourish to every settled decision. A dissonant card requests room for one more person's birthday. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Abschluss erhält einen abschließenden Nachschlag.

variant_notes.note_en: Believes every conclusion deserves one last unnecessary flourish.
